newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Sept domestic vehicle sales up 8.4% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Sept domestic vehicle sales up 8.4% yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's domestic vehicle sales rose 8.4 percent from a year earlier to 511,911 units in September, the Japan Automobile Dealers Association said on Tuesday.
Domestic sales for the April-September period totalled 2.50 million units, up 2.4 percent from the same period in 1995, the association said.
The September sales breakdown was as follows (with percentage changes from a year earlier):
September vehicle sales by five major Japanese makers were as follows (with percentage changes from a year earlier):
Nissan Motor Co Ltd 108,810 up 0.9 percent
Honda Motor Co Ltd 45,741 up 26.3 percent
The April-September sales breakdown was as follows (with percentage changes from a year earlier):
April-September vehicle sales by five major Japanese makers were as follows (with percentage changes from a year earlier):
Nissan Motor Co Ltd 514,179 down 1.1 percent
Honda Motor Co Ltd 258,537 up 40.1 percent

Domestic sales of imported vehicles rose 5.7 percent from a year earlier to 38,017 in September, bringing cumulative April-September sales to 211,567, up 10.9 percent from the same 1995 period, the association added.
